reproduction: Clone nift-dev/nift at public_ancestor_sha; git apply --binary nift-frozen.patch; git add -A; git write-tree must equal source_tree_sha. Build ordinary CLI with make.
implementation_difference: Between public release ancestor and frozen source, the only C++ difference is src/CLI.cpp version_text changing 4.10.0 to 4.11.0; other differences are release/version documentation and metadata. Official binary rebuilt from frozen tree.
